# v26.0 WP10: "敕令归正" — Imperial Edict of Religious Conformity for Provincialised Subjects (oe_rome_sub_II).
# Costs 10 Pillars Imperial Authority, adds +25 liberty desire, and peacefully converts oe_rome_sub_II to the overlord's faith.
# Generated by gen_v260_cul_rel_overhaul.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_rome_sub_edict_conversion = {
    type = subject
    category = CATEGORY_SUBJECT_ACTIONS
    ai_tick = never
    use_enroute = no
    block_when_at_war = no

    cooldown = {
        type = oe_rome_sub_edict_conversion
        years = 10
    }

    potential = {
        scope:actor = { oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes }
    }

    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes
            exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
                custom_tooltip = {
                    text = oe_rome_sub_edict_conversion_auth_tt
                    has_variable = oe_pillars_authority
                    var:oe_pillars_authority >= 10
                }
            }
        }
    }

    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = {
                every_subject = {
                    limit = { is_subject_type = oe_rome_sub_II }
                    add_to_list = source
                }
            }
        }
        target_flag = recipient
        name = choose_country
        default_sort = will
        column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
        only_color_selectable = yes
        map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
        visible = {
            is_subject_type = oe_rome_sub_II
            is_subject_of = scope:actor
            NOT = { religion ?= scope:actor.religion }
        }
        enabled = {
            subject_loyalty >= 50
            liberty_desire < 50
        }
    }

    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                exists = scope:recipient
                exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
                international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
                    has_variable = oe_pillars_authority
                    var:oe_pillars_authority >= 10
                }
                scope:recipient = {
                    is_subject_type = oe_rome_sub_II
                    is_subject_of = scope:actor
                    NOT = { religion ?= scope:actor.religion }
                }
            }
            custom_tooltip = oe_rome_sub_edict_conversion_effect_tt
            hidden_effect = {
                international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
                    change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -10 }
                }
            }
            enforce_religion_effect = {
                actor = scope:actor
                target = scope:recipient
            }
            scope:recipient = {
                add_liberty_desire = 25
            }
        }
    }
}
